pages.title: Cryobot
pages.text: A probe that melts its way down through ice with the heat of a radium core, paying out a tether behind it: NASA's plan for reaching Europa's ocean. Used standing on Titan's Subsurface Seal, it melts through into the hidden ocean below; used there, it climbs its tether back to the surface.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Reticular Chemistry.
